# Which model gets which ticket

- **Plans, specs, unclear problems:** Top seat (Fable)
- **Well-specified tickets:** Mid seat (Opus or Codex)
- **Mechanical changes and docs:** Local seat (Qwen on the Mac)

Codex reviews every PR. One P1 blocks the merge; P2s don't.
